second_engine.action: Native isolated Firefox QA launch via Start-Process
second_engine.reason_detail: Automatic approval review provided no detailed reason. No alternate launcher was attempted after rejection.

limits: Screenshots require separate human visual inspection.
CSS root text enlargement is exercised; native browser zoom, OS font preferences and screen-reader behavior are unverified.

public_format.conversion: JSON serialized as UTF-8 with LF. Path-to-SHA256 maps are represented as arrays of path/sha256 records; other original fields and values are preserved. Original receipt bytes remain in the private review archive.
